feeds.title: LupusCorner
feeds.description: Lupus Corner connects you to the most engaging and informative content on Lupus as well as to other people battling the condition.

feeds.title: Lupus Trust » Lupus News & Blog
feeds.description: The Lupus Trust was established to fund vital lupus research at Guys Hospital. We also help people learn about lupus, the treatment of lupus, and living with lupus.

feeds.title: Kaleidoscope Fighting Lupus
feeds.description: Kaleidoscope Fighting Lupus Blogs are a series of informative, content rich blogs covering varied topics such as; lupus rash, lupus symptoms, lupus fog, etc. Our purpose is to educate the public and medical providers about lupus, a serious and sometimes deadly auto-immune disease, and to push foundations and governments to fund research toward its cure.

feeds.title: Lupus LA Blog
feeds.description: Lupus LA is a lupus foundation in Los Angeles CA dedicated to finding the causes of and a cure for lupus while providing support, services and hope to all people affected by lupus, throughout Los Angeles and Southern California.

feeds.title: More Than Lupus Blog
feeds.description: More than Lupus was created as a place for those who were just diagnosed, or those that have been living with lupus for decades. Here, they can connect, grow, and inspire others through the peaks and valleys of their lupus journey.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Lupus
feeds.description: Read the latest research on lupus and related autoimmune diseases, including new experimental treatments. ScienceDaily features breaking news about the latest discoveries in science, health, the environment, technology, and more -- from leading universities, scientific journals, and research organizations.

feeds.title: Lupus News Today
feeds.description: Lupus News Today is a digital platform intended to provide the lupus community with the most recent news and information, as well as first-hand community perspectives from our patient and caregiver columnists. The publishing team at Lupus News Today is made up of science writers and editors, most of whom have PhDs in the life sciences, veteran journalists, and columnists who are members of the lupus community.

feeds.title: Lupus Lyfe
feeds.description: I'm Britt Clark and I have lupus. I was diagnosed in 2016 and have spent that last couple of years looking for ways to physically, mentally, financially, and spiritually accept my diagnosis. I started Lupus Lyfe to help share tips, information, awareness, and hope to other lupus warriors.

feeds.title: Lupus in Color
feeds.description: Lupus In Color brings positive hope to lupus warriors one butterfly at a time! Lupus In Color is an international support group dedicated to educating, inspiring, encouraging, and empowering lupus warriors worldwide. They cater to the needs of men, women, and children of all colors of the rainbow affected with Lupus.

feeds.title: Despite Lupus
feeds.description: Sara Gorman was diagnosed with systemic lupus at the age of 26. Committed to working with the disease rather than against it, she made it her top priority to start living well, despite lupus. On her blog, Despite Lupus, you can read about ongoing developments in the treatment of the disease and Sarah's personal stories of living life with lupus.

feeds.title: Lupus in Flight
feeds.description: Lupus In Flight is a blog and was created by Shaista Tayabali. It became her lifeline when she was critically ill and also a place where she gathered all the disparate threads of an uneasy life of living with chronic illness. This blog teaches her how to be heard and how to be imaginative while living a solitary life.

feeds.title: Lupus Society of Illinois
feeds.description: The Lupus Society of Illinois (LSI), formed in 1973, is the Midwest's leading non-profit health organization dedicated to finding the causes and cures for lupus. LSI promotes lupus awareness and complements the work of health care professionals by providing personalized resources for the lupus community while supporting research.

feeds.title: My Story Living With Lupus Blog
feeds.description: These are my trials, and triumphs of living with lupus. Through this blog, you will learn how I never gave up hope and continue to preserve living with lupus. Susan Lynne Hendrix, MHA, PH.D. has three degrees in the field of health and science, she is a past member of the American Health Care Association. But most importantly she is living her best life in spite of lupus.

feeds.title: Wots Her Name Again? » Living with Lupus
feeds.description: Living with Lupus can be a tough journey, however Wots Her Name Again is here to support you with some helpful advice, encouragement and Lupus life hacks.

feeds.title: Getting Closer To Myself
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Dr. Leslie Rott Welsbacher. In April 2008, at the age of 22, I was diagnosed with lupus and rheumatoid arthritis. The Getting Closer To Myself blog is about a lot of things in my life, but focuses on my experiences with illness, in the hopes that my story will help others.

feeds.title: More Than My Lupus
feeds.description: Hi! I'm a 30-something-year-old. This is a personal blog about my battle with lupus and fibromyalgia and how I have continued to live my life despite these chronic illnesses because I am More Than My Lupus. I provide guidance, solidarity, and support for those with similar diagnoses, and insight for loved ones and healthcare workers.

feeds.title: Luck Fupus Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts range from serious - like one about the complications of a recent double mastectomy - to the outrageously humorous. One thing we particularly like about LuckFupus is its realness. Life isn't all bad, even when you're fighting lupus, and it certainly isn't all great. Striking a balance and finding a reason to be joyful, no matter what the situation, seems to be working for MarlaJan.

feeds.title: Lupus, the Adventure Between the Lines
feeds.description: It's hard to think of a health problem, like having Lupus, as an adventure, since an adventure could be confused with sounding like such a positive thing. But, the goal of this blog is to give awareness and information to people about lupus.

feeds.title: The Lupus Liar Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about lupus, book a speaker and presenter on lupus awareness, education, and advocacy.

feeds.title: Undefeated Diva
feeds.description: Undefeated Diva was created by Christina Polanco, a fiery Latina that doesn't take 'no' for an answer. She was diagnosed with Lupus in March 2011 and have decided to kick it's ass ever since. She is a warrior and created this blog to raise awareness against Lupus.

feeds.title: World Lupus Federation Blog
feeds.description: The World Lupus Federation (WLF) is a coalition of lupus patient organizations, united to improve the quality of life for all people affected by lupus. Through coordinated efforts among its affiliates, the Federation works to expand global initiatives that create greater awareness and understanding of lupus, provide education and services to people living with the disease and advocate on their behalf.

feeds.title: THE LUPUS ENCYCLOPEDIA
feeds.description: The Lupus Encyclopedia Blog gives practical advice on how to live with lupus. People with lupus have a lot in their control. A patient education blog about lupus and related disorders. I post information about important new lupus study results in easy-to-understand language. I post practical information on how patients can take better care of themselves, fight the disease, and live with lupus in the best way possible by means other than just taking medications. I remind patients that knowledge is power.

feeds.title: Lupus Research Alliance
feeds.description: We are the world's leading private funder of lupus research. Our goal: improve treatments while advancing lupus research toward a cure.

feeds.title: The Life of a 20-Something With Lupus
feeds.description: Miz Flow writes openly and honestly about her struggles with lupus, like affording treatment as a recent college graduate and dealing with hospital visits, as well as other events in her life, like the passing of a friend. But through it all, she remains positive, even injecting regular doses of laugh out loud humor.

feeds.title: Lupus Crazy Blog
feeds.description: Lupus Crazy is about what life is like living with Lupus. Whether you have been diagnosed or a loved one may have the disease, we can help.

feeds.title: Sometimes It Is Lupus
feeds.description: Iris Carden is a former journalist and church minister. She was diagnosed with lupus in 2006. She started Sometimes, it is Lupus to chronicle her journey, bring attention to the disease, and connect with other lupus patients.
